Dialogs.Dialog: Let's see, addition formula... ...All right, I solved it!
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Nice work.
▲小早川＊▲？ How long have you been there？
A little while.
...Sorry, I didn't notice.
I got to see something nice, so I don't really mind.
Something nice...？
My boyfriend from the side, working hard.
You looked really cool, all focused like that.
(Glad I worked so hard!)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Aren't you pretty popular with the girls lately？
Where did that come from？
Like, 'Whoa, you can solve such hard problems! Amazing! You're so cool!' ...They don't tell you that？
Not really, no.
I see. So I'm the only one who thinks it's cool, huh.
N-Nothing, never mind.
You just said it was cool...
I did NOT say anything like that! ...Stupid.
Kobayakawa
You're super popular, Teach.
Teach...？
You were tutoring those other students. I was watching the whole time. Like a real teacher.
Hahaha... They just said there was something from math class they didn't understand.
Being able to teach it like that is amazing.
Hey, Teach. Will you be nice and tutor me in math sometime too？▼
(Being called Teach, huh... Doesn't feel half bad.)
(I'm the only one whose experiment worked, huh... Man, that feels great.)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. What are you doing...？
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲. Just cleaning up after the lab.
Hmm... And why are you doing it alone？
Well, I was just in a really good mood, so I kinda... volunteered to do it.
Seriously, you're such a... ...Well, whatever. I'll give you a hand.
Huh？ No, you don't have to.
It's fine. You were the only one whose experiment worked, right？
Huh？ You knew about that!？
Of course I know. You worked hard.
(All right, I'm gonna try even harder!)
(A perfect score on the physics pop quiz! All that hard work paid off.)
Kobayakawa
Hey, you're not pushing yourself too hard... right？
I'm not. Why, what's up？
Watching my boyfriend work too hard makes me worry as his girlfriend, you know.
If you collapsed on me, I wouldn't know what to do with myself, you know.
Hey, take it easy. I'm fine. I'm not pushing myself.
...Okay. That's good, then. Well... I'll just say this.
Good for you. Makes me kinda happy, too. ...Congrats▼
(I'm glad I worked so hard!)
(A perfect score on the quiz!)
Kobayakawa
Hey, teach me math sometime too, okay？
Sure, but there aren't any easy shortcuts, you know.
Really...？ Aw, man. I thought I'd get good at math and science too.
...You just thought there's no way I could do it, didn't you.
I-I did not!
It's all over your face. As punishment, you have to tutor me gently and carefully.
And you can't say no, got it？ It's a punishment. One-on-one, okay!
(That's a punishment I can get behind!)
Yes! The teacher praised me. All that work on classical grammar paid off.
Kobayakawa
Getting so excited just 'cause you did a little well. What are you, a kid？
Questions like that are a breeze for me too, you know？
...I-I couldn't help it, I was just happy.
Don't look so bummed out. I went too far. Sorry.
Congrats.
Eh？
Earlier, you know... people were looking our way. For real... you worked hard. Congratulations.
...Hey, wipe that grin off your face already.
(That's such a ▲小早川＊▲ way of putting it, but now I'm motivated again!)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Um, hey...
Your reading in class earlier was really cool.
Haha, I got called on out of nowhere, so I panicked a bit.
With no practice？ You just winged it...？
That teacher always does that.
Hey. Teach me the trick to reading aloud sometime.
The trick, huh... Putting emotion into it, maybe. Wanna try right here？
Right here？ With emotion, huh. ...I guess I can try.
▲主人公＊▲. I really... love you... a lot. ...How was that？
Y-Yeah... I think... it's good. (Was that... a reward for me？)
(I got a pretty great grade on my essay.)
Kobayakawa
By the look on your face, your essay went well, huh.
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲.
You could act happier! Oh, I know. Your girlfriend'll praise you.
Eh！？
Amazing. Totally perfect. Good for you, good for you. I'm suuuper happy too!
That sounded kinda forced...
Look... Don't you get it？ How dense can you be？
I'm doing my best to praise you in my own way here...
(I'm really happy too!)
I finally finished reading that book for class!
Kobayakawa
Oh... That's the book I gave up on. I see. ...Not bad.
When the teacher first gave us the assignment, I thought it was impossible too.
Maybe I'll give it another try myself...
You should! Let's talk about it once you finish it, okay？
...Yeah. That sounds kind of fun.
Right？
Pushing each other like this is nice. I always kind of wanted that... Hehe.
When I'm with you, I feel like I can take on just about anything. Thanks.
(It was tough going, but finishing that book was totally worth it!)
I feel like I can beat anyone in the humanities right about now!
Kobayakawa
Beat anyone in the humanities, huh. Even me, right？ ...Hmm.
▲小早川＊▲. Wait, are you mad...？
There's nothing wrong with having some confidence.
(She's definitely mad... Maybe I got a little too carried away.)
Hehe... Scared you, huh？ My boyfriend worked hard. Why would I be mad？
O-Oh, man...
I mean...
How hard you work like that... is something I really love about you. Keep it up▼
(Now I feel like I can push myself even harder!)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Nice going.
Huh...？ What do you mean？
Oh, please. I mean in class just now.
The teacher praised you, right？ Said your classical lit translation was spot-on.
That was fast! How do you know that？
Hehe. My intel network on my boyfriend is airtight.
An intel network on me, huh...
I want to be the first to praise you. As your girlfriend, y'know.
Good job, good job... Hehe▼
(I'll have to keep it up next time, too!)
Not to brag, but I think this painting turned out pretty well.
Kobayakawa
......Haaah.
Huh...？ Why the sigh？ Is my painting weird...？
I'm impressed, actually. Looking at these colors, were you influenced by Fauvism？
F-Fauvism...？
Someday your name is definitely going down in art history.
Oh, right. I should get your autograph.
Now you're exaggerating!
Hehe... True. Still, I really do mean it when I say I like this.
(That's the best praise I could ask for!)
I think I can safely call this painting some of my best work.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Were you always good at painting...？
Hmm... I don't know about good, I just like drawing.
Huh... Let me see.
Oh, are you embarrassed？ Heh, then I'm gonna take a real close look.
Y-You don't have to get that close... So, how is it？
I'm no expert, so I can't tell if it's good or not.
But the brushstrokes, the colors... I like all of it. I love this painting. Do you need anything more？
(All right!)
Now that I've gotten this far, it's almost finished.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Aren't you going to show me...？
I still haven't put the finishing touches on it... Wanna see？
Yeah, let me see. Whoa... You've got good taste. You paint stuff like this too？
I can't wait till it's done. You'll show it to me first, of course, right？
Of course I did.
Yay. Girlfriend privileges, huh？ Heheh.
(She's looking forward to it, so I'll give it one last push to finish it up!)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Looked like your classmates were crowding around you？
I drew an illustration in art class, and a bunch of people said they wanted it.
Let me see it too.
...That's super cool. Looks like a fighting game character. If it were, I'd definitely use them!
I drew it with you in mind, ▲小早川＊▲, so I'm really glad to hear you say that.
With me in mind...？ Heheh, thanks. Can I have this drawing？ I'll treasure it!
Oh... Then let me redraw it properly for you!
This one's fine. A one-of-a-kind drawing you made just for me. That's more than enough.
(I'm glad she liked it.)
Getting praised by the teacher really motivates you, huh.
Kobayakawa
Hmm... More than getting praised by me？
Ah... Uh, no... You heard that？
Guess the art teacher has a good eye after all. Well, I noticed your talent a long time ago, though.
Oh, you did？
Obviously. Do I have to spell it out every single time？
Well... I guess not...
Then...
I know every single good thing about you. ...I am your girlfriend, after all.
(Hearing it from ▲小早川＊▲ definitely motivates me way more!)
Choir practice has really brought our class together!
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Looked like you were really taking the lead in there.
Taking the lead is a bit of an exaggeration.
In my class, there isn't really anyone who can step up and lead...
What about ▲小早川＊▲？
Me, a leader？ No way! I'm not the type at all.
I'd like to see it, though. You as a leader, ▲小早川＊▲. I think you could do it.
Y-You think so？
Well... you're working hard too, after all. Okay, I'll give it a try.
(All right, I'll do my best too!)
(I played really well this time!)
Kobayakawa
Music class has guys and girls together, right？
Yeah, it does. Why do you ask？
I just got to thinking how other girls are watching you play...
You don't need to look so cool when you play, you know.
You only need to be cool when you're in front of me...
(Could it be... she's jealous...？)
The chorus in class today went pretty well.
Kobayakawa
I knew that was your class.
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲, you were listening？
I couldn't help overhearing. Well... it was good. You guys sounded nice, but...
But...？
Your voice was the only one I could hear.
Was I singing that loud？
Not really. It's more like...
Guess my ears just tune in to my boyfriend's voice... Hehe.
Playing music has gotten pretty fun lately.
Kobayakawa
You've been working at it. You're doing great!
You think so...？
What？ Are you saying you don't trust my word？
No, no, that's not it...
I mean it, seriously. You have a real knack for playing.
(A real knack for it, huh... Alright, I'll keep it up!)
(That went really well!)
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲. Did you hear me play？
Kobayakawa
Yeah. It was pretty good, I guess？
That's all...？
Out here... yeah.
Jeez... fine, then.
You were so cool, I fell for you all over again. ...Hehe▼
(I'll do my best next time too!)
Yes! A new best time!
Kobayakawa
Nice. All that practice paying off？
Am I getting too excited just beating my own record？
Not at all. It's an impressive record.
You think...？ Hearing that from you gives me confidence, ▲小早川＊▲.
Well then...
▲主人公＊▲. Hip, hip, hooray, go for it, go for it♪
...Hehe. Just so you know, I'm always cheering for you▼
(All right! I'll keep it up next time!)
Kobayakawa
First place？ You were amazing out there.
Yeah! I was in great form today.
Sigh... Why couldn't I have been born a year earlier？
Eh？
Then we could've been in the same class, and I could cheer for you out in the open.
You can cheer for me anyway.
That's... embarrassing. Everyone's watching. So instead...
Make sure you look even cooler, just for me...
(I'll do my best next time too!)
Goal! Scoring the winning point really feels great.
Kobayakawa
Look at you, all fired up.
I want to look good in front of you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Because it's in front of me...？
Of course！
Not so loud... Other people are gonna hear.
Listen... I think you looked cool, okay.
Huh？ I didn't catch that.
I said you looked cool! Geez... Don't make me repeat myself. ...I'm counting on you next time, too.
（Yes!）
All right, a comeback win!
Kobayakawa
That three-pointer at the end! I never thought you'd make it from that far out.
Hahaha, it was about half luck, though.
Luck is part of skill. Right？
Plus, I had the goddess of luck watching over me!
You mean... me？ Geez... That's embarrassing! Don't say it so loud.
Guess I have no choice. ...I'll do my best to stay one.
Huh？ I didn't catch that.
I said I'll do my best to stay your goddess! ...Don't make me repeat myself.
(All right, I'll do my best too!)
Huff... huff, huff... All right... I finished!
Kobayakawa
Good work. Long-distance running for the boys？ That's rough.
I went into a full sprint... right at the very end... Huff... huff...
Getting that serious over gym class. ...You're such an idiot.
Once I spotted you, ▲小早川＊▲, I couldn't help it... Hahaha.
For... me？
I mean, I just naturally try harder when I'm in front of you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Then... since my boyfriend worked so hard, I guess I have to give him a reward.
Seeing you give it your all... You looked really cool.▼
（Yes!）
Doesn't look like many books are getting checked out today. Just gotta tidy the shelves.
▲小早川＊▲. You didn't have to run.
Kobayakawa
But... today was supposed to be my shift, right？ ...Sorry.
Don't worry about it. There wasn't much to do today anyway.
...Yeah.
Come on, don't look so down. I just went ahead and took your shift on my own.
Then I'll help out the next time you're on duty. Is that okay...？
Sounds good. I'll count on you, then.
Okay! Oh... and... thanks for always helping me out▼
(All right!)
All right... Just need the teacher's stamp on the supply list and I'm done for today!
Kobayakawa
Supplies... Oh, didn't they say we were almost out of printer paper and stuff？
Oh, thanks. I'll add it to the list.
...Yes!
I've just been relying on you so much lately. Being useful for once... hehe, kind of made me happy. ...Weird, huh.
Hey, we help each other out.
Right. We help each other out. So I'm actually being a help to you too... That's a relief.
Helping each other out. ...I like the sound of that.
Yeah, let's do it!
Phew... It feels great seeing the library all neat and tidy!
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. It's not your shift today, is it...？
I saw books left out and just couldn't leave them there.
Not being able to leave books sitting out... You're a true library committee member now.
Wait, are you only just now giving me your approval...？
Yup！
...Just kidding. You're always the one I count on the most. You know that, right？
(Man, that makes me happy!)
All right, that wraps up the draft for the library paper!
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. You worked extra hard on it this time.
Only because I had your help, ▲小早川＊▲.
I only came up with the ideas for the layout. You're the one who came up with all the content.
Come on, ▲小早川＊▲, you did the book review column...
Look at us complimenting each other. Kind of weird.
Hahaha, yeah, you're right.
We put so much into this, so I hope everyone reads it.
Yeah, sure.
Well, while we're on a roll, want to start planning the next issue, Editor-in-Chief？
(Editor-in-Chief, huh... All right, I'll do my best!)
Phew... All that hard work paid off. Finished sorting the shelves ahead of schedule!
Kobayakawa
Good work. You did all of it... by yourself.
I've got the routine down now, so I don't have to ask you for help anymore, ▲小早川＊▲.
I see. Guess you don't need me anymore, then. You're fine on your own.
Yeah, leave it to me!
Are you really okay... alone？ If you're lonely without me, you could just say so.
Yeah... good point. Let's keep doing it together.
What am I gonna do with you... If you insist, I guess I don't mind.
Um... Actually, I'll just say it. I'd rather do it together than alone, too. ...Hehe.
(Definitely better together!)
(Feels like I'm in great shape today.)
Kobayakawa
Hey！
!!!？ Oh, it's you, ▲小早川＊▲. ...You startled me.
Heheh. That's what you get for spacing out.
Geez...
Come on, don't be mad. It's no big deal.
...So, what's up？
Nothing really. I just... saw you swimming, so I came over, and...
I was thinking, like, how cool you look, and how big you are...
Hehe... My boyfriend's really someone to be proud of!
(She's making me blush!)
Kobayakawa
▲小早川＊▲. What is it...？
N-no... It's nothing.
Up close, you're actually pretty well-built, huh... Your shoulders and chest...
Ugh, what am I saying？ Forget what I just said! I mean it!
O-okay.
Come on, let's swim! Hurry up!
(I'll give it my all next time, too!)
